steps.description:
Add a last name.
The last name is required if you want to create a family from this person.
After saving, the full name shows as the title of the form.
steps.label: Last Name
steps.title: Last Name

steps.description:
Membership says how this person is connected to the church: Member, Regular Attender, Visitor or Contact. Adding a Membership life event sets Member for you. Let's choose Visitor for now.

Pick a Membership to continue.
steps.label: Membership
steps.title: Membership

steps.description: Status is Active for everyone who still takes part in the church. Set it to Inactive when someone leaves, and give the reason. A Death life event sets it for you.
steps.label: Status
steps.title: Status

steps.description:
You can add the positions that this person has been or is now assigned.
Go ahead and assign this person a 'Secretary' position starting today. Click the Add Row button below.
steps.label: Positions
